name: Very Merrytime Vegetarian Holiday Pumpkin, Brown Lentil & Apple Curry with Rice
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime ("Happy Holidays" Menu)
whyItWorks: Dairy-free coconut/pumpkin curry over steamed basmati rice, though whole brown lentils add fermentable FODMAPs and insoluble hulls.
prepOrOrderInstructions: During a flare, eat the steamed basmati rice and tender pumpkin pieces while leaving most of the fibrous brown lentils behind.
watchOuts: High fiber and gas-producing oligosaccharides from whole brown lentils
